summary: rec.gov + FS read. Fixes: potable_water true -> false (rec.gov and FS both say no water), season closes 09-07 -> 09-30 (rec.gov season May 15-Sep 30) with off-season FCFS note, max_rig_ft 63 (note prose) -> 60 (catalog), count 20 + pull_through; fees now $15 off-season / $26 with $6 extra vehicle; booking fcfs some_sites, 14-night limit. Phone empty -> (605) 673-9200.
flags: PHONE: empty -> (605) 673-9200 (Hell Canyon Ranger District, from the FS page). The concessioner's line on rec.gov is (661) 702-1420.

FACILITIES: the FS page says 'Restrooms are not available at this site', which contradicts rec.gov's 'vault toilets' (and the off-season notice 'Vault toilets are also available'). The FS line looks like an unfilled template field; vault_toilets kept true.

SIZE: the off-season notice says 'Parking Spur Length is 25 ft' - that covers the 5 off-season FCFS sites and still fits a 23-ft rig. Only 2 of 20 catalog sites post an RV length (52 and 60 ft); the old '28-63 ft' range is on no current page.
NOTICE: 'Please note: Construction is pending, which may cause limited access.' (off-season section) - status left open; the FS page shows 'Site Open'.

PIN: stored 43.73490,-103.71350 is ~170 m north of the catalog site centroid 43.73342,-103.71367 (inside 250 m, not moved). The rec.gov facility point 43.73639,-103.70222 is ~1 km east and wrong; the FS point 43.73459,-103.71453 is fine.
OHV: rec.gov's generic forest text mentions riding OHVs on the forest; nothing marks this as an OHV campground.
WATERFRONT: not waterfront - confirmed (no water in sight on imagery).
